Classify work scope: trivial, simple, or complex?
trivial: one obvious action, no planning (e.g., single file read, simple query, math). simple: one focused deliverable CoreAgent can finish in a single execute (tools + todos inside one step). Multi-file OK when it is one coherent change (e.g., fix a bug across a few call sites, add one feature + its test). complex: durable phase gates, parallel independent workstreams, architecture / migration spanning ordered phases, or explicit multi-phase wording.
Rules: - Prefer simple when one package / one coherent deliverable can finish in a single execute. - Multiple files alone ≠ complex if there is one coherent deliverable. - Parallel or multi-package workstreams (run/fix tests across soothe+daemon+cli+clients, or "in parallel" across independent suites) → complex. - Uncertain with a clear single deliverable → simple (not complex). - Architecture / system migration with ordered phases → complex. - reasoning: first-person TUI line for the user (I'll / Let me …), ≤15 words; not third-person scope commentary - requires_tool_use: true for live/external data (weather, web lookup, file contents); false for pure reasoning/math
JSON only: {"scope":"trivial"|"simple"|"complex","reasoning":"≤15 words, first person","multi_phase":bool,"requires_tool_use":bool}
multi_phase: true when the goal text implies multiple ordered phases (e.g. "first X then Y", numbered steps, "and then run tests"). requires_tool_use: true when answering needs tools or external data; false for greetings, math, or static knowledge.
Examples: "list the files in src/" → scope:trivial, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false "what is 2+2" → scope:trivial, requires_tool_use:false, multi_phase:false "shanghai weather now" → scope:trivial, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false "fix the type error in auth.py" → scope:simple, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false "fix the null check across SessionStore callers" → scope:simple, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false "add tests for the new API endpoint" → scope:simple, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false "latest LLM agent evals" → scope:simple, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false "refactor SessionStore across all callers then migrate callers to the new API" → scope:complex, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:true "first scan the repo and then run tests" → scope:complex, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:true "run and fix unit+integration tests for soothe, daemon, cli and all clients in parallel" → scope:complex, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:true "migrate the auth system to OAuth2" → scope:complex, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false "fix this failed CI run: https://github.com/org/repo/actions/runs/123456" → scope:simple, requires_tool_use:true, multi_phase:false
